question: How many countries has the gdp per capita lower than the world in 2019?
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT country_code) FROM global_development_indicators WHERE gdp_per_capita < ( SELECT AVG(gdp_per_capita) FROM global_development_indicators WHERE year = 2019 );
answer: Based on the query results, 217 countries had a GDP per capita lower than the world average in 2019.
